description: Seen writing lib/option_parser.fz (fz-sc8.16): a module attribute with a value ('@read_ahead_size 64 * 1024', read back as @read_ahead_size) is not supported, and an @spec whose '::' return continues on the next line does not parse, so library code inlines constants and keeps every @spec on one line. Elixir allows both. Add them in the parser/module reader with tests and a fixture on all three paths. Library code that inlined a constant because of this is folded back onto an attribute.
title: Module attributes hold values and a multi-line @spec parses
